def git_repo_multi_branch(git_repo_with_spec):

    import subprocess

    repo_dir = git_repo_with_spec

    branches = {
        "openEuler-24.03-LTS": "23.0.0",  # 同版本同 spec -> 同组
        "openEuler-24.03-LTS-SP1": "23.0.0",  # 同版本同 spec -> 同组
        "openEuler-22.03-LTS-SP4": "22.0.0",  # 不同版本 -> 不同组
    }

    for branch_name, version in branches.items():
        subprocess.run(["git", "checkout", "-b", branch_name], cwd=repo_dir, check=True, capture_output=True)
        spec_file = os.path.join(repo_dir, "test-package.spec")
        with open(spec_file, 'r') as f:
            content = f.read()
        content = content.replace("Version:        23.0.0", f"Version:        {version}")

            f.write(content)
        subprocess.run(["git", "add", "."], cwd=repo_dir, check=True, capture_output=True)
        subprocess.run(["git", "commit", "-m", f"Update to {version}"], cwd=repo_dir, check=True, capture_output=True)

    # 切回 master

def test_tools_dir_variable_exists():

    expected = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(conftest_dir, '..', '..'))

def git_repo_multi_branch(git_repo_with_spec):
    """创建多分支仓库（master + openEuler 分支，不同版本）"""
    import subprocess

    repo_dir = git_repo_with_spec

    branches = {
        "openEuler-24.03-LTS": "23.0.0",  # 同版本同 spec -> 同组
        "openEuler-24.03-LTS-SP1": "23.0.0",  # 同版本同 spec -> 同组
        "openEuler-22.03-LTS-SP4": "22.0.0",  # 不同版本 -> 不同组
    }

    for branch_name, version in branches.items():
        subprocess.run(["git", "checkout", "-b", branch_name], cwd=repo_dir, check=True, capture_output=True)
        spec_file = os.path.join(repo_dir, "test-package.spec")
        with open(spec_file, 'r') as f:
            content = f.read()
        content = content.replace("Version:        23.0.0", f"Version:        {version}")
        # 如果版本与 master 相同，添加一个区分性注释以避免空提交
        if version == "23.0.0":
            content += f"\n# Branch: {branch_name}\n"
        with open(spec_file, 'w') as f:
            f.write(content)
        subprocess.run(["git", "add", "."], cwd=repo_dir, check=True, capture_output=True)
        subprocess.run(["git", "commit", "-m", f"Update to {version}"], cwd=repo_dir, check=True, capture_output=True)

    # 切回 master
    subprocess.run(["git", "checkout", "master"], cwd=repo_dir, check=True, capture_output=True)

    return repo_dir
